questions.question: INT-VER-002 says near-2^64 behaviour is reached by writing the timer value registers. Should counting from a low value up through ordinary increments (e.g. the lower-to-upper carry at 2^32) also be exercised by natural counting, or only by writes? Rules RT-7-02 and RT-7-05 are unclear on this.
